QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR LANDING PAGES
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
Do landing pages need to be separate from the main site?
Not necessarily. We build landing pages that live on your domain and can rank organically. Subdomain landing pages are also an option for paid-only campaigns.
How many variants do you test?
We typically run 2–4 variants per test, with headline and hero as the first things we test. Each test runs until statistical significance (95% confidence).
